failure_definition: Thrombus formation on mechanical heart valves causing obstruction
causal_mechanism: Platelet adhesion and coagulation activation on artificial surfaces due to the lack of a negatively charged glycocalyx
current_device_behavior: Mechanical heart valves currently allow thrombus formation due to their artificial surfaces
failure_point: The blood-contacting surfaces of the mechanical heart valve
blocking_constraint: The need for an implantable power source to activate the negative surface charge, which limits the practicality of the proposed modification
